profile.headline: Software Engineer | Python, SQL, C/C++ | Agile & TDD | Azure DevOps | Data & Database Development
profile.summary:
Results-driven and detail-oriented Software Engineer, aiming to leverage my comprehensive experience in programming, database development, and data analysis into a challenging software engineering role. Proficient in a wide array of programming languages such as Python, C, C++, Java, SQL, and Plus.

My practical involvement in various projects, coupled with a fervent dedication to innovation and an ongoing pursuit of learning, positions me as a vital contributor to any organization aiming to achieve substantial technological advancement.

I'm eager to continue leveraging my skills and passion for technology to drive success and innovation. Feel free to connect or reach out if you'd like to discuss opportunities or collaboration.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: As a Software Engineer at Unisys, I led initiatives to modernize and maintain our relational database systems on OS2200 mainframes. I practiced test-driven development and utilized CI/CD pipelines which improved deployment reliability and reduced production bugs. Collaborating with international teams, I ensured 24/7 system support and documentation. I also contributed to a generative AI project by integrating Microsoft Azure AI tools into an internal Q&A application, helping reduce support ticket response time and improving internal knowledge access.

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description: As an Associate Software Engineer, I focused on backend development and database operations using SQL and proprietary Unisys tools. I wrote unit and regression tests to ensure code quality and system stability. I worked closely with senior developers and QA to identify and resolve performance issues, which enhanced customer-facing product reliability. My involvement in Agile teams helped streamline workflows, resulting in faster feature delivery and improved collaboration.

positions.title: Technology Systems Intelligence intern
positions.description: As a Technology Systems Intelligence Intern, I developed real-time dashboards in Power BI to help leadership visualize and understand transit vehicle data. I used SQL, Microsoft Access, and Python to clean, analyze, and integrate large IoT datasets from Transit Master. I automated C-Line incident notifications with PowerShell, reducing manual oversight and ensuring timely alerts. Additionally, I designed a Transit Signal Priority (TSP) dashboard, helping stakeholders evaluate the effectiveness of signal-based traffic prioritization, contributing directly to data-driven route planning decisions.
positions.insights: Skills: SQL · Microsoft Access · Visual Basic · Microsoft Power BI · Power BI · Automation

positions.title: Management Analyst 1
positions.description: As a Management Analyst I with the State of Minnesota, I led a statewide initiative to collect and analyze data on Child Welfare services through a comprehensive SNAP survey. I designed a new research database, converting Excel data into Microsoft Access to enhance data querying and organization. To streamline data extraction from large, complex survey outputs, I automated processes using Python. I also supported web updates via the Tridion content management system and used Tableau to visualize findings for stakeholders. Throughout the project, I prepared, cleaned, and validated datasets to ensure accuracy and readiness for research and reporting.
positions.insights: Skills: Python · Pandas · SQL · Microsoft Access · html · Automation · Tableau

positions.title: Facilitator - Urban Scholars Leadership Institute
positions.description: As a Returning Scholar and Facilitator for the Urban Scholars Leadership Institute, I co-led weekly sessions for a cohort of 30 new scholars. In a team of five, I prepared and delivered 1–2 hours of interactive leadership content each week, focusing on professional development and civic engagement. I also completed 20 hours of project management training, enhancing my ability to guide teams and structure learning experiences.

positions.title: Experiential Education Center Student Worker
positions.description: As a student worker at the Experiential Education Center, I managed student records using industry-standard software, performing full CRUD operations to ensure accuracy. I generated custom reports for program planning and extracted volunteer data from Volgistics, preparing email campaigns via mail merge. I also designed promotional materials and provided front-desk support, including phone assistance and campus tours, enhancing student engagement and visibility of campus programs.

positions.title: Campus Cupboard Student Worker
positions.description: As a Campus Cupboard assistant, I managed and updated student records in Campus Track, tracked inventory, and submitted monthly Excel-based reports to monitor usage trends. I also maintained the food inventory system, uploaded stock data, and controlled physical access to ensure a secure and welcoming environment for students facing food insecurity.

positions.title: Vice President – STEM Club
positions.description: As Vice President of the Normandale STEM Club, I helped organize biweekly meetings and hands-on learning activities. I tutored students in 3D modeling using Fusion 360 to design objects like fidget spinners and helped coordinate club events that promoted STEM education across campus.

positions.title: President
positions.description: As Math Club President, I organized weekly meetings, secured guest speakers on math-related topics and internships, and promoted events through flyers, emails, and the school’s e-blast system. I also represented the club at campus involvement fairs to attract new members and build community interest.

positions.title: Information Technology Intern
positions.description: As an IT Intern, I developed test data and wrote SQL stored procedures to manage Transportation Network Company (TNC) driver information. I collaborated with airport departments to create visual reports for airport police using Microsoft tools, improving visibility into transportation data and trends.

positions.title: Math Tutor
positions.description: As a math tutor, I supported a group of 25 eighth-grade students by helping them solve homework problems and strengthen foundational math skills. I focused on guiding students toward independent problem-solving by asking strategic questions and encouraging critical thinking.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: As an intern, I assisted with intake and placement testing by making phone calls to prospective students, setting up testing environments, and providing student support with access to school resources, helping ensure a smooth onboarding process for adult learners.

honors.issuer: Issued by The North Central Section of the Institute of Transportation Engineers (NCITE)  · Nov 2019

honors.issuer: Issued by Minnesota High Tech Association · Aug 2018

projects.title: TSP dashboard
projects.description: Selected to present at the2nd Annual Innovation in Transit Performance Measurement Challenge for the TRB Annual Meeting (2020) held in Washington D.C sponsored by Standing Committee on Transit Management and Performance (AP010) and the Subcommittee on Information on Transformative Trends in Transit Data (AP000(3))
